title: Starter Lattice — onboarding snapshot pack
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a compact, exportable asset pack for the Console first-run onboarding flow tailored for three personas (Developer, Platform Admin, Security Officer). Deliverables include: modular checklist tiles, three empty-state illustrations with contextual CTAs, four product screenshot compositions (desktop + narrow), two lightweight spotlight animations (Lottie JSON), and a microcopy sheet with intl-ready strings. Assets must match console-2026.03 visual tokens and be optimized for performance in the web onboarding tour (SVGs for illustrations, 2x PNGs for screenshots).
acceptance_criteria: Modular checklist tiles (SVG + PNG) for steps: Connect model, Create route, Run sample request, Review cost/latency — each tile exported in 1x/2x and with ARIA label suggestions
Three empty-state illustrations (Developer, Admin, Security) exported as optimized SVGs with mask layers and a fallback PNG
Four annotated product screenshots showing: onboarding checklist open; empty API keys; first successful inference; cost snapshot — all in 1440x900 and 1200x630 for social
Two spotlight animations exported as Lottie JSON (max 80KB) and a GIF fallback under 200KB
Microcopy file with canonical English strings and placeholders for i18n; includes CTA variants (primary/secondary) and error/retry copy
Accessibility checklist completed: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for all text, focus states visible, alt-text for all images
Assets added to Figma page and linked in the Console onboarding PR with file names matching the asset index
screenshot_requirements: Desktop compositions: 1440x900 base artboard, UI chrome cropped to emphasize checklist region. Provide 1200x630 crop for marketing/social. Include overlay annotations in a separate layer (Figma) and provide redline px measurements for dev. All screenshots must hide real api keys and use "REDACTED" placeholders.
microcopy_snippets: Welcome to Redwood Console — let’s get your first route live.
Step 1: Connect a model — choose from the catalog or bring your own.
Step 2: Create a route — a stable endpoint for your app to call.
Step 3: Run a sample request — verify latency and output quality.
You’re all set — monitor costs and roll out with canaries when ready.
No API keys yet — generate a key to start issuing requests.
Need help? View quickstart guide or open a support ticket.
If you’re on a private deployment, confirm network and KMS access before proceeding.
accessibility_checks: Color contrast: primary CTA text on CTA background >= 4.5:1
Focus ring present for all interactive checklist tiles (2px offset, 3px ring)
SVGs annotated with <title> and <desc> for screen readers
All images have alt text in asset_index_manifest.txt
Animations have reduced-motion variants and can be disabled via data-attribute
decisions: Use modular tiles (single SVG with symbol instances) to enable dynamic checklist ordering in the Console UI.
Spotlight animations will be Lottie for small file size and smooth motion; GIF fallback only for older email clients.
Empty-state illustrations follow a low-poly geometric motif to align with Console hero art while remaining distinct from marketing visuals.
Microcopy will use sentence case and avoid product jargon in the primary CTA to improve first-time completion rates.
Ship minimal variants for v1; add persona-specific CTA copy after A/B signal from telemetry.
tasks: Engineering: integrate assets and ensure ARIA labels (ENG-3421)
PM: link assets to onboarding PR and schedule QA (PM-410)
Design review: cross-check with Brand team for tone and token usage
